question: The pH of Saliva of a Healthy Human mostly ranges from ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.2 to 7.6.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The acronym **pH stands for potential hydrogen.** It describes the chemical acidity level vs the alkalinity level of the substance.
 
• **99% of saliva is made of water** and the remaining** 1% consists of digestive enzymes, uric acid, electrolytes, cholesterol and mucus-forming proteins.**
